license_audit.section_13_analysis: Section 13 of AGPL-3.0 requires offering network-interacting users the source code of the modified version if modified software is run as a network service.
license_audit.compliance_decision: Relay connects strictly as an external API consumer over HTTP webhooks and REST endpoints. Any host modifications (the triage hook) are encapsulated within a minimal, self-contained hook module (<30 LoC) maintained in a local shadow/comparison harness. Relay itself is an independent service with its own license, eliminating AGPL contamination while fully complying with upstream terms.
